changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0066. Trainers record dated member progress without replacing earlier assessments. Measurements stay nullable so a missing value is not stored as zero. Index review: PK_MemberProgressAssessments. FKs to Tenants, MemberProfiles, TrainerProfiles, and optional BodyMeasurements. IX_MemberProgressAssessments_Member_Date loads one member's history by date. Performance note: the trainer progress screen reads one assigned member inside the current tenant.
changeSet.sql: SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON; IF OBJECT_ID(N'app.MemberProgressAssessments', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE app.MemberProgressAssessments ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, MemberProfileId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TrainerProfileId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, BodyMeasurementId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, AssessmentDate DATE NOT NULL, UnitSystem NVARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, Weight DECIMAL(8, 2) NULL, Waist DECIMAL(8, 2) NULL, Chest DECIMAL(8, 2) NULL, Hip DECIMAL(8, 2) NULL, Arm DECIMAL(8, 2) NULL, Thigh DECIMAL(8, 2) NULL, BodyFatPercentage DECIMAL(5, 2) NULL, FitnessScore DECIMAL(5, 2) NULL, TrainingPerformance NVARCHAR(500) NULL, Notes NVARCHAR(1000) NULL, AchievedGoals NVARCHAR(500) NULL, NextGoals NVARCHAR(500) NULL, PhotoConsent BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_MemberProgressAssessments_PhotoConsent DEFAULT 0, PhotoStorageKey NVARCHAR(200) NULL, PhotoContentType NVARCHAR(80) NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_MemberProgressAssessments PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_MemberProgressAssessments_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_MemberProgressAssessments_MemberProfiles FOREIGN KEY (MemberProfileId) REFERENCES app.MemberProfiles (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_MemberProgressAssessments_TrainerProfiles FOREIGN KEY (TrainerProfileId) REFERENCES app.TrainerProfiles (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_MemberProgressAssessments_BodyMeasurements FOREIGN KEY (BodyMeasurementId) REFERENCES app.BodyMeasurements (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Unit CHECK (UnitSystem IN (N'Metric', N'Imperial')), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Weight CHECK (Weight IS NULL OR (Weight > 0 AND Weight <= 500)), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Waist CHECK (Waist IS NULL OR (Waist > 0 AND Waist <= 500)), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Chest CHECK (Chest IS NULL OR (Chest > 0 AND Chest <= 500)), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Hip CHECK (Hip IS NULL OR (Hip > 0 AND Hip <= 500)), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Arm CHECK (Arm IS NULL OR (Arm > 0 AND Arm <= 500)), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Thigh CHECK (Thigh IS NULL OR (Thigh > 0 AND Thigh <= 500)), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Fat CHECK (BodyFatPercentage IS NULL OR BodyFatPercentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Score CHECK (FitnessScore IS NULL OR FitnessScore BETWEEN 0 AND 100), CONSTRAINT CK_MemberProgressAssessments_Photo CHECK (PhotoConsent = 1 OR (PhotoStorageKey IS NULL AND PhotoContentType IS NULL)) ); CREATE INDEX IX_MemberProgressAssessments_Member_Date ON app.MemberProgressAssessments (TenantId, MemberProfileId, AssessmentDate) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; END

rollback.sql: IF OBJECT_ID(N'app.MemberProgressAssessments', N'U') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE app.MemberProgressAssessments;
